message: Me tocó buscar por dónde caminar en Kennedy: la corriente tapó el borde del andén y solo se puede avanzar por la parte seca. Pilas los que vienen a pie. #Bogota #inundacion

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0002: Eye-level vertical smartphone photo taken from a pedestrian's dry strip of sidewalk looking diagonally along a narrow residential street in Kennedy, Bogotá, Colombia. Brown shallow floodwater completely hides the curb boundary; the dry narrow pavement in the immediate left foreground is the only walkable part. Concrete and red-brick two-storey Colombian houses with turquoise and rust-colored metal doors. Frame the flowing water close and obliquely, without a zebra crossing. No one in the current.
